data.long_meaning: The name Iwaz is derived from the Arabic word 'awwaj' which means lion. It is a powerful and courageous name that is often given to boys in the Islamic world. The name Iwaz carries the meaning “Lion” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu. Parents who choose Iwaz usually hope their child will grow to embody lion and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_urdu.name: ایواز
